(Phonetic pronunciation: shee-AHNG lee-OH)

Welcome!
I’m a PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Minnesota.
My research interests lie at the intersection of industrial organization, international trade, and growth and development. My current work focuses on how transportation markets and global shipping networks shape trade costs, market access, and industrialization and development in emerging economies, using both empirical and theoretical tools.
